description: Top Bittensor network validators in Taostats' rank order (global weighted stake: root stake plus alpha stake valued in TAO, across all subnets), with their validated subnet counts, dominance %, nominator counts, and commission take. Requires TAOSTATS_API_KEY. Related tools on this server, for a different need: crypto_tao_subnet_validators when you need top validators of a specific Bittensor subnet by stake; crypto_tao_network when you need Bittensor network fundamentals: block height, total issued. Price: $0.005 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
name: crypto_tao_top_validators
